content: Using all of the New York Times data available, we created vector space models for each year using the methods described in Section SECREF10. Table TABREF22 shows the ten nearest neighboring words (by cosine similarity) to our vector representation of all LGBTQ terms, which is the weighted average of the embeddings of the LGBTQ terms from Table TABREF19. For visual convenience, words that occurred fewer then ten times and proper names are not shown. We also filtered out other LGBTQ labels and forms of the word heterosexual from these lists, as these words were commom neighbors for all terms across all years.
